issue.standard_remedy: Route off-contract buying to contracted suppliers
issue.summary: 61% of category spend is off contract

plan.diagnosis: Electric motors category has 61% maverick spend ($47,963,090 out of $78,981,680 total) across 9 plants, indicating lack of contract enforcement and likely absent or bypassed sourcing controls in multiple ERP systems. This direct material category requires immediate procurement governance to capture negotiated pricing and quality standards.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct urgent audit across all 9 plants to identify all non-contracted electric motor suppliers currently in use, transaction volumes, and root causes (missing source lists, requisitioner behavior, emergency purchases, local preferences)
remedy_steps.owner: Category Manager - Electric Motors with plant procurement leads

remedy_steps.step: Implement hard sourcing controls in all ERPs: configure source lists in SAP (ME01), approved supplier lists in Oracle EBS (PO_APPROVED_SUPPLIER_LIST), purchase policies in Dynamics 365, preferred vendor rules in NetSuite, and policy controls in Coupa to restrict electric motor purchases to contracted suppliers only
remedy_steps.owner: ERP System Admins coordinated by Procurement IT Lead

remedy_steps.step: Communicate contract compliance mandate to all 9 plants with clear escalation process for genuine exceptions (technical specs not covered, emergency breakdown); establish exception approval workflow requiring Category Manager sign-off above $10,000
remedy_steps.owner: Head of Procurement with Plant Managers

remedy_steps.step: Negotiate contract amendments or new agreements to cover identified gaps in specifications, delivery locations, or service levels that drove maverick buying; consolidate volume to achieve additional 8-12% savings on redirected spend
remedy_steps.owner: Category Manager - Electric Motors with Strategic Sourcing

remedy_steps.step: Launch monthly compliance monitoring dashboard tracking contract utilization % by plant and supplier, with plant scorecards; address non-compliance through management escalation

plan.expected_impact: Redirecting $47,963,090 maverick spend to contracted suppliers at negotiated rates will yield $4,300,000 to $5,750,000 in annual savings (9-12% price improvement plus reduced administrative costs)
kpis: Contract utilization rate for electric motors category (target: increase from 39% to 90% within 6 months)
Maverick spend reduction (target: reduce $47,963,090 to under $7,900,000)
Number of non-contracted POs for electric motors (target: <5% of total PO count)
Average unit price variance vs. contract baseline by plant
Exception request volume and approval rate
risks: Production disruption if contracted suppliers cannot meet lead times or technical specifications that maverick suppliers currently fulfill
Plant resistance and workarounds if sourcing controls are too rigid without reasonable exception process
Contracted supplier capacity constraints when absorbing $47.9M incremental volume
Implementation delays across 5 different ERP systems with varying technical capabilities
Loss of competitive tension if incumbents become complacent without maverick alternatives
erp_actions: SAP: Create source lists (ME01) for electric motors material group restricting to contracted vendors; set source list requirement indicator in material master (MRP2 view)
SAP: Block creation of new vendor masters for electric motor suppliers without Category Manager approval (LFA1 central block)
Oracle EBS: Populate PO_APPROVED_SUPPLIER_LIST with contracted vendors only for electric motors commodity codes; enable Approved Supplier List enforcement
Dynamics 365: Configure procurement policy rules to require contracted vendors for electric motors category; set up workflow for exception requests
NetSuite: Mark contracted electric motor vendors as Preferred; create saved searches to flag and block non-preferred vendor requisitions in category
Coupa: Update sourcing policy with electric motors spend control; configure supplier block list for known maverick vendors; enable contract-based requisitioning
All ERPs: Add mandatory requisition field capturing contract reference number for electric motors purchases above $5,000
